content: Aɣewweɣ n Cabɛa

Tuɣa din ijj n weryaz i war isekkwin, qqaren as Cabaɛ, mmis n Bikri, ijj n Ubinyamini. Netta isuḍ deg uyicc n icarri, inna: “Neccin war ɣarneɣ tasɣart di Dawud u neccin war ɣarneɣ řwart ak-d mmis n Yassa. Ejj kuř aryaz ad yuyur ɣar iqiḍan nnes, a Israil!”
Xenni iffeɣ kuř aryaz zi ḍeffar n Dawud, iruḥ awarni i Cabaɛ, mmis n Bikri. Maca iryazen n Yahuda qqimen řesqen ak-d ujeǧid nsen, zi L’Urdun ař Urcalim.

Umi yudef Dawud ɣar taddart nnes di Urcalim, iksi ujeǧid ɛecra n temɣarin, tiyya nnes tinni tuɣa ijja awarni as ḥima ad ḥḍant taddart. Netta igga i-tent deg ict n taddart tᵉttwaḥḍa u netta itthilla daysent, maca war ɣarsent yudif. Nitenti qqiment bellɛent ař ass n řmewt nsent, ddarent d tijjař.
Inna ujeǧid ɛawed i Ɛamasa: “Řaɣa-dd x yeryazen n Yahuda ad munen ɣari di třata n wussan, uca xenni bedd cek da!”
Ɛamasa iffeɣ ḥima ad iřaɣa x Yahuda ad ssmunen, maca netta iɛeṭṭeř x řweqt i tuɣa akides igga ujeǧid.

Xenni inna Dawud i Abicay: “Řexxu ad aneɣ igg Cabaɛ, mmis n Bikri, tuɛeffna mahu x Abcalum. Ksi akidek imsexxaren n sidi u ḍfar i-t, ḥima netta war izemmar ad yaf i yixef nnes tineddam ifaryen uca ad iweddar zi tiṭṭawin nneɣ.”
Ffɣen yeryazen n Yuwab, uyuren awarni as ak-d iɛessasen n arrimet d ireqqasen n tazřa d marra ayt n bu-teɣruḍt. Nitni ffɣen-dd zi Urcalim, ḥima ad ḍfaren Cabaɛ, mmis n Bikri.

Umi ten tuɣa ɣar weẓru ameqqran n Jibɛun, tuɣa Ɛamasa zzat i wudem nsen. Yuwab tuɣa ittḥezzam arruḍ nnes n umenɣi i yarḍ. Tuɣa xas ijj n uḥezzam ak-d ssif deg ufurru n weɣřaf i xas ittwaggen ɣar tejɛinna nnes. Umi yuyur netta ɣar zzat, iwḍa as ssif zzayes.
Inna Yuwab i Ɛamasa: “Aqa cek mliḥ, uma?” Icebbar Yuwab s ufus afusi di tmart n Ɛamasa ḥima ad t issudem.

Ɛamasa war iḥekkar i ssif i tuɣa deg ufus n Yuwab uca netta iřqef i-t zzayes deg uɛeddis uca ffɣen as-dd wadan ɣar temmurt. Netta immut břa ma iřqef i-t ict n twařa nneɣnit. U Yuwab ak-d umas Abicay iḍfar Cabaɛ, mmis n Bikri.
Ijj n weryaz ibedd ɣares ɣar Ɛamasa. Tuɣa netta zeg imsexxaren n Yuwab, inna: “Ejj wenni ixḍaren Yuwab uřa d wenni iǧan ak-d Dawud, ad iḍfar Yuwab!”

Ɛamasa maca tuɣa izzeř ittwanneḍ deg idammen nnes deg webrid ameqqran. Umi iẓra aryaz nni, aqa marra řgens iqqim ibedd, ijarr netta Ɛamasa zeg webrid ɣar yeyyar u inḍar ijj n warruḍ tiwa nnes, minzi iẓra qaɛ wi ɣares dd-iwḍen, iqqim ittbedda.
Ařami tuɣa netta ittwaggʷej x webrid, ɛdun marra iryazen awarni i Yuwab, ḥima ad ḍfaren Cabaɛ, mmis n Bikri,
wenni tuɣa ikka x marra tiqebbař n Israil ɣar Abal u ɣar Bayt-Maɛka, ak-d marra Ibiriyyen nni ittwassmunen u ruḥen ɛawed awarni as.

Ammu dd-iwḍen nitni ɣar din uca nnḍen-dd i Cabaɛ di Abal-Bayt-Maɛka. Nitni ssefyen ijj n lbaraj x tendint u lbaraj nni ibedd ɣar řḥiḍ n zzat i dd-innḍen i tendint. Marra řgens i tuɣa ak-d Yuwab, ggin ad areddǧen řḥiḍ ḥima ad as ssɣeḍřen.
Xenni třaɣa ict n temɣart d tmiɣist zi tendin:t “Sřem, sřem, inim i Yuwab: ‘As-dd da, ades-dd, ařami zemmareɣ akidek ssiwřeɣ.’”
Umi dd-yusa netta, yudes-dd ɣares, tenna temɣart: “Ma cek d Yuwab?” Netta inna: “D necc.” Tenna as nettat: “Seř ɣar wawařen n tayya nnec.” Netta inna: “Necc ttesřiɣ.”
Xenni tenna: “Zic tuɣa ssiwřen di kuř amcan, nnan: ‘Ittxeṣṣa asen ad tt sseqsan nican di Abal!’, uca ammu i kemmřen nitni tamesřact nni mliḥ.
Necc zeg inni n ayt n řehna u zeg imtiqqan di Israil, maca cek texsed ad tenɣed ict n tendint, tenni d yemmas di Israil. Mayemmi ɣa tṣarḍed řwart n SIDI?”
Yuwab yarra-dd xas, inna: “Aya iggʷej xafi aqa necc ad ṣarḍeɣ u ad hedmeɣ!

Tamesřact war teǧi amenni. Maca ijj n weryaz zeg idurar n Ifrayim, qqaren as Cabɛa, mmis n Bikri, iksi afus nnes x ujeǧid, x Dawud. Netta waha ittxeṣṣa ad t tewcem, xenni ad ḥeyydeɣ zi tendint.” Tenna temɣart i Yuwab: “Xzar, azeǧif nnes ad ac t-i-dd-immenḍar tiwa i řḥiḍ.”

Tusa-dd temɣart s tiɣit nnes ɣar marra řgens u nitni qessen azeǧif i Cabɛa, mmis n Bikri, nḍaren t i Yuwab. Xenni isuḍ Yuwab deg uyicc n icarri u nitni bezzɛen ixef nsen, aggʷejen x tendint u kuř aryaz yuyur ɣar iqiḍan nnes u Yuwab iɛqeb ɣar Urcalim, ɣar ujeǧid.
Imdebbaran imeqqranen n Dawud
Yuwab ittwagg d azeǧif x marra řɛeskar n Israil, u Banaya, mmis n Yahuyadaɛ, tuɣa x iɛessasen n arrimet u x ireqqasen n tazřa.
Aduram ibedd x ljizya u Yahucafaṭ, mmis n Axilud, tuɣa-t d amarir n umezruy.
Ciwa tuɣa d amarir, u Ṣaduq d Abyatar tuɣa aten d ikehhanen.
Uřa d Ɛira zi Ya’ir tuɣa d akehhan n Dawud.
